node.title: Re^4: webperl: fetching data over the web
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Ah, I see - the democode stuff is [https://github.com/haukex/webperl/tree/master/web/democode|in the repo], and it'll also be part of the next release. webperl_demo.html uses [https://webperl.zero-g.net/using.html#perlmakeoutputtextareaid|Perl.makeOutputTextarea(id)], which merges STDOUT and STDERR (which I just [https://github.com/haukex/webperl/commit/ca4c2f57e023ca819d688e9123b618fa60ed9242|added] to the documentation, thanks :-) ).
